title: Tags attached to messages disappear.
creator: phonoscape
content:
Hello,

I have been using Thunderbird, but the tagging behavior has become erratic since version 153.

The phenomenon is as follows:

  • Tags attached to messages are disappearing on their own.
  • The tags disappear when I select a message or receive a new email.
  • It does not occur with the default tags (such as "Important"), but only with the ones I registered myself.
  • It also occurs in troubleshooting mode.

Is there a solution?

Regards.
